verbatim: - For adults with chronic kidney disease who meet the EMPA-KIDNEY eligibility criteria — an eGFR of at least 20 mL/min/1.73 m² with albuminuria, or an eGFR of 20 to 45 mL/min/1.73 m² — the trial supports expecting kidney and cardiovascular protection to continue after treatment stops, at a diminished level and mainly in the year after withdrawal [2]<!-- claim:CLM-015 --><!-- claim:CLM-016 -->. This is practice context for the population studied: the trial enrolled adults with an eGFR of at least 20 mL/min/1.73 m², the estimates come from a single randomized trial, and the post-trial period is an open observational extension in which only 74% of randomized participants took part; the results do not extend to dialysis-dependent or transplanted patients.
whyItIsWrong: Practice summary says eGFR at least 20 with albuminuria or 20-45, omitting the <90 upper bound and >=200 albuminuria threshold specified in results line 37 / CLM-006.
note: Keep trial eligibility boundaries in summaries; do not let prose generalization expand the trial population. Keep the supported artifacts and calculations; correct or qualify the affected statement only. No human approval is required.
